decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler is core to the heat exchange portfolio for process and energy customers and costs little to keep while the firm expands.
Air cooled condensers remain a standard offering for power and refrigeration customers and fit the established manufacturing base.
Despite overlap with Product B, the second condenser variant serves distinct applications, and the earlier withdrawal of Product E suggests consolidation has already been handled elsewhere.
Tube liners support the high-margin lifecycle repair business that is central to the firm's service strategy.
Tube end repair inserts strengthen the spare parts and repair offering with low ongoing resource needs.
